Location

The neighborhood is characterized by well-maintained apartment buildings, green spaces, and a pleasant, established residential environment.  Shops for daily needs, bakeries, pharmacies, and medical practices are within walking distance. Schools, kindergartens, and other everyday facilities are located nearby. The Hardtberg district also offers a high recreational value with nearby green and wooded areas, sports facilities, as well as walking and cycling paths. The location is particularly suitable for professionals, project staff, and families who value quiet living combined with good accessibility.

The apartment is particularly suitable for professionals, project workers, expats, or families in a transitional phase who are looking to stay in Bonn for a limited period of time.
